cleavage agent: The enriched proteoglycans were then digested with trypsin
collision energy: scan 1 at the HCD collision energy of 30% with the scan range from m/z 100 to 2000, scan 2 at the HCD energy of 40% with the scan range from m/z 300 to 2000, and scan 3 at the HCD energy of 40% with the scan range from m/z 100 to 2000... MS/MS spectra were recorded for each precursor with the collision energy at 20%, 30%, and 35%.
enrichment method: A two-step SAX enrichment procedure was developed to isolate CS glycopeptides in larger quantities from human urine.
fragmentation method: Three separate higher-energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) MS/MS spectra were recorded for each precursor
instrument: The samples were analyzed on an Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer
ionization type: Nanospray Flex ion source was operated in positive ionization mode at 1.8 kV.
labeling: To assess the abundance of each glycoform, spectral counts of annotated MS/MS scans from the proteomic database searches were used
ptm: variable modifications of the residual 6-mer structure (993.2808 u) for [HexA(-H2O)GalNAcGlcAGalGalXyl-O-] with 0, 1, or 2 sulfates or phosphates attached; variable modifications of 8-, 10-, and 12-mer oligosaccharides, all with varying levels of sulfation

Proteomic database searches were designed to include variable modifications of the residual 6-mer structure (993.2808 u) for [HexA(-H2O)GalNAcGlcAGalGalXyl-O-] with 0, 1, or 2 sulfates or phosphates attached... the searches were allowed to include variable modifications of 8-, 10-, and 12-mer oligosaccharides, all with varying levels of sulfation.
